statements: This representation mimics the well-studied image-based 2D bounding-box detection but comes with additional challenges.
Objects in a 3D world do not follow any particular orientation, and box-based detectors have difficulties enumerating all orientations or fitting an axis-aligned bounding box to rotated objects.
However, during a safety-critical left turn (bottom), anchor-based methods have difficulty fitting axisaligned bounding boxes to rotated objects.

evidence.quote: On the Waymo Open Dataset, CenterPoint outperforms all previous single model method by a large margin and ranks first among all Lidar-only submissions.
Our best single model achieves 71.8 and 66.4 level 2 mAPH for vehicle and pedestrian detection on Waymo, 58.0 mAP and 65.5 NDS on nuScenes, outperforming all published methods on both datasets.

deploymentClaims: Our end-to-end 3D detection and tracking system runs near real-time, with 11 FPS on Waymo and 16 FPS on nuScenes.
For example, in autonomous driving, the sensor often only sees the side of the object, but not its center.
